# Renewal Follow-Up Demo
## 60-day email → 30-day call → 7-day email + call → weekly until resolution
# Full details and workflow code on GitHub
# [github.com/Marhey/practical-ai-workflows](https://github.com/Marhey/practical-ai-workflows/tree/main/n8n/renewal-follow-up)
Sample-data demo built with AI assistance. Template drafts and call tasks only. No emails sent.

return rows.map((r, i) => ({ json: {
  accountId: r[0],
  renewalCycleId: 'RC-2026-' + r[0].slice(-4),
  accountName: r[1],
  renewalStatus: r[2],
  daysUntilRenewal: r[3],
  contactName: r[4],
  contactEmail: r[5],
